# LM3 manufacturing methods and tooling

<!-- Generated by tools/automation/buildable-trainset.sh; do not hand-edit. -->

Pilot local-manufacture route for one LM3 three-car trainset; elapsed allowances support factory planning but never override a released material datasheet, supplier manual, WPS, adhesive open/cure time, or competent engineering decision.

**Release boundary:** Not a construction release. Supplier freeze, controlled drawings, structural calculations, fire/rail evidence, qualified special processes, first-article tests, independent safety assessment, and national authorisation remain mandatory.

## LM3-MFG-010 — Locally fabricated steel body, bogie and interface structures

- Work centre: local steel preparation, weld and metrology cells
- Crew / planning cycle: 6 people / 72 hours elapsed
- Product IDs: `LM3-BDY-P010`, `LM3-BDY-P020`, `LM3-BDY-P030`, `LM3-BDY-P040`, `LM3-BDY-P050`, `LM3-BDY-P060`, `LM3-BDY-P070`, `LM3-BDY-P080`, `LM3-BDY-P090`, `LM3-BDY-P100`, `LM3-BDY-P110`, `LM3-BDY-P120`, `LM3-ART-P010`, `LM3-BOG-P010`, `LM3-BOG-P020`
- Tooling: `LM3-TOOL-STEEL-FIXTURE`, `LM3-TOOL-DATUM-GAUGE`
- Joining parts: released structural welds; machined datum inserts; OSR-FST-M8-FLOAT only for calculated secondary interfaces; galvanic-isolation shims
- Release gate: Controlled cut/flat-pattern pack, WPS/WPQR, qualified welders, weld map, NDT plan, dimensional survey and released structural proof.

| Seq. | Planning time | Instruction | Hold point |
|---:|---:|---|:---:|
| 10 — Release material and fixture | 120 min | Verify drawing revision, heat certificates, section/plate identity, fixture calibration and datum targets before cutting. Quarantine substitutions. | yes |
| 20 — Cut, form, machine and deburr | 960 min | Produce the controlled cut list and flat patterns; protect datum and bond lands; identify every primary part to heat and drawing position. | no |
| 30 — Fixture, tack and survey | 480 min | Load parts against the 3-2-1 datum scheme, install calibrated shims/stops, tack to the released sequence and survey before production welding. | yes |
| 40 — Qualified weld and controlled cool | 1680 min | Execute only the released weld map/WPS with heat-input and consumable records; use a balanced sequence and controlled cooling or stress relief where specified. | no |
| 50 — NDT, machine datums and coat | 1080 min | Complete VT and classed MT/UT, repair through an NCR, machine released interfaces, survey the frame, restore edge/cavity protection and record coating batches. | yes |

## LM3-MFG-020 — Reusable one-metre GFRP body/roof moulds and split end-cowl moulds

- Work centre: local composite moulding, cure, trim and dry-fit cell
- Crew / planning cycle: 3 people / 24 hours elapsed
- Product IDs: `LM3-BDY-P130`, `LM3-BDY-P140`, `LM3-CWL-P010`, `LM3-CWL-P011`, `LM3-CWL-P012`, `LM3-CWL-P013`, `LM3-CWL-P014`, `LM3-CWL-P015`, `LM3-CWL-P016`, `LM3-EXT-P080`, `LM3-EXT-P090`
- Tooling: `LM3-TOOL-SIDE-MOULD`, `LM3-TOOL-ROOF-MOULD`, `LM3-TOOL-COWL-MOULD`, `LM3-TOOL-TRIM-DRILL`
- Joining parts: potted threaded inserts; solid laminate clip lands; OSR-FST-M6-CAPTIVE; keyed over-centre clips; replaceable EPDM dry seals
- Release gate: Released laminate/core/insert map, fire evidence, material shelf life, mould survey, vacuum leak check, cure record, witness coupon, trim report, insert pull-out sample and master-frame dry fit.

| Seq. | Planning time | Instruction | Hold point |
|---:|---:|---|:---:|
| 10 — Inspect, clean and release mould | 60 min | Inspect mould A-surface, split line, vacuum ports and datums; clean with the qualified system and apply the released semi-permanent release process. Record mould and release lots. | yes |
| 20 — Apply exterior finish primer or gelcoat | 75 min | Apply the released UV/fire-compatible finish layer at controlled wet-film thickness. The supplier minimum/maximum overcoat window overrides this planning allowance. | no |
| 30 — Load reinforcement, core, solid lands and inserts | 180 min | Place identified dry plies, local core and solid laminate lands to the released ply book; pot or fixture inserts and build a co-cured witness coupon. | yes |
| 40 — Bag, leak-test and infuse | 120 min | Install peel ply/flow media/bag and resin lines, record a stable vacuum leak test, then infuse within supplier temperature, viscosity and working-time limits. | yes |
| 50 — Cure in mould | 720 min | Hold the supplier-qualified time/temperature cure and record thermocouples. Do not demould on elapsed time alone; cure acceptance or hardness/Tg evidence controls release. | yes |
| 60 — Demould, trim, seal and dry-fit | 285 min | Demould without prying on show surfaces; inspect/tap-check, CNC trim and drill in the datum fixture, seal every cut edge, install inserts/seals, gauge the part and dry-fit it to the master frame. | yes |

## LM3-MFG-030 — Solar-reflective, high-emittance exterior coating and thermal witness route

- Work centre: local preparation and controlled paint cell
- Crew / planning cycle: 2 people / 16 hours elapsed
- Product IDs: `LM3-BDY-P130`, `LM3-CWL-P011`, `LM3-CWL-P012`, `LM3-CWL-P013`, `LM3-CWL-P014`, `LM3-CWL-P015`, `LM3-CWL-P016`
- Tooling: `LM3-TOOL-COATING-RACK`, `LM3-TOOL-COATING-COUPON`
- Joining parts: compatible primer/topcoat system; sealed GFRP edges; coated witness coupons; replaceable external labels
- Release gate: Rail fire/smoke compatibility, substrate/primer compatibility, adhesion, weathering, cleanability, colour/glare review and measured new/aged solar reflectance and thermal emittance. No cooling or energy saving may be claimed before vehicle thermal testing.

| Seq. | Planning time | Instruction | Hold point |
|---:|---:|---|:---:|
| 10 — Condition and inspect substrate | 60 min | Verify cured laminate, sealed edges, moisture/temperature limits and defect repair; mask bonds, seals, datums, windows, sensors and electrical earths. | yes |
| 20 — Prepare and prime | 120 min | Abrade and clean only by the released coating procedure, apply compatible primer and coat a traceable witness coupon beside the vehicle modules. | no |
| 30 — Apply reflective/emissive topcoat | 120 min | Apply the selected light-colour rail topcoat to controlled wet/dry film thickness. Avoid unqualified experimental radiative-cooling chemistry and review glare/visibility with the authority. | no |
| 40 — Controlled cure | 600 min | Maintain supplier temperature, humidity and ventilation limits; the released coating datasheet controls flash, recoat, cure and return-to-service times. | yes |
| 50 — Inspect and retain coupons | 60 min | Record film thickness, adhesion/cure acceptance, colour/gloss and measured solar reflectance/emittance; retain labelled coupons for accelerated weathering and cleaning trials. | yes |

## LM3-MFG-040 — Replaceable side-window cassette, pressure frame, seal and drain installation

- Work centre: local glazing preparation and vehicle fit-out cell
- Crew / planning cycle: 2 people / 3 hours elapsed
- Product IDs: `LM3-BDY-P110`, `LM3-WIN-P010`, `LM3-EXT-P020`, `LM3-EXT-P030`
- Tooling: `LM3-TOOL-WINDOW-GAUGE`, `LM3-TOOL-WATER-TEST`
- Joining parts: supplier-bonded aluminium glazing cassette; replaceable closed-cell/EPDM outer seal; aluminium pressure frame; OSR-FST-M6-CAPTIVE; drain rail and jack points
- Release gate: Supplier glazing/edge certificate, retained frame calculation, approved surface preparation, seal compression map, drain test, water-ingress test, heater/isolation test where fitted and timed replacement demonstration.

| Seq. | Planning time | Instruction | Hold point |
|---:|---:|---|:---:|
| 10 — Receive and inspect cassette | 25 min | Confirm pane/cassette identity and orientation; inspect laminate, edges, frame bond and heater terminals. Quarantine any edge impact, delamination or expired adhesive evidence. | yes |
| 20 — Gauge aperture and dry-fit | 35 min | Gauge carrier-ring datums and drains, protect glass edges, place the cassette on nonmetallic setting blocks and confirm uniform design clearance without forcing the glass. | yes |
| 30 — Install dry seal and pressure frame | 55 min | Fit the one-piece keyed seal without stretch, lubricants or unapproved sealant; install the pressure frame and tighten captive fasteners in the released cross-pattern to the joint schedule. | no |
| 40 — Verify compression, drains and services | 25 min | Measure seal compression at the released witness points; confirm drain continuity, secondary retention, electrical isolation and heater continuity where fitted. | yes |
| 50 — Water and replacement test | 40 min | Run the controlled spray test, inspect the dry side and drains, then remove/refit the first article with the documented lifting/jacking method and record elapsed replacement time. | yes |

## LM3-MFG-050 — Supplier door cassette on locally made four-point adjustable carrier

- Work centre: local door preparation, installation and static-test cell
- Crew / planning cycle: 3 people / 5 hours elapsed
- Product IDs: `LM3-BDY-P100`, `LM3-DOOR-P010`, `LM3-EXT-P010`
- Tooling: `LM3-TOOL-DOOR-GAUGE`, `LM3-TOOL-SEAL-GAUGE`
- Joining parts: four adjustable carrier shoes; two hardened datum pins; replaceable dry perimeter seal; OSR-FST-M10-SEAL; keyed body-side connector bracket
- Release gate: Supplier and interface freeze, carrier load proof, EN 14752/national evidence as applicable, datum and seal maps, closed-and-locked loop, obstacle detection, emergency release, water test and timed cassette replacement.

| Seq. | Planning time | Instruction | Hold point |
|---:|---:|---|:---:|
| 10 — Accept supplier cassette and portal | 45 min | Verify serial/revision/evidence, inspect seals/leaf/drive and gauge the locally made portal and four carrier datums before lifting the cassette. | yes |
| 20 — Lift, pin and adjust carrier | 75 min | Use the approved lift points; engage datum pins, install four carrier shoes and adjust only within their released range to achieve leaf/aperture geometry without distorting the cassette. | yes |
| 30 — Join, seal and connect | 60 min | Install sealed fasteners to the controlled joint schedule, fit the keyed replaceable seal and connector, retain service loops and record final adjuster positions and witness marks. | no |
| 40 — Static functional and safety tests | 75 min | Test open/close cycles, obstruction detection, closed-and-locked circuit, traction interlock, emergency release, local isolation and degraded/manual operation under the supplier procedure. | yes |
| 50 — Ingress and replacement demonstration | 45 min | Run the controlled water test and first-article removal/refit; repeat safety tests after replacement and record time, tooling and adjustments. | yes |

- Tooling: `LM3-TOOL-FLOOR-TEMPLATE`, `LM3-TOOL-FIXTURE-PROOF`
- Joining parts: removable sealed floor boards/hatches; rail-qualified resilient floor covering; OSR-RAIL-42; OSR-FST-M8-FLOAT; calculated seat/handrail saddles; OSR-FST-QT-CAPTIVE access panels
- Release gate: Fire/smoke certificates, substrate moisture/flatness, adhesive batch and open time, seam/edge detail, slip resistance, hatch removal, fixture load calculations and proof samples, PRM/egress gauge and snag/rattle inspection.

## LM3-MFG-090 — Three-car final assembly, static test and manufacturing release

- Work centre: 55 m local final assembly and static-test road
- Crew / planning cycle: 8 people / 48 hours elapsed
- Product IDs: `LM3-END-P010`, `LM3-END-P040`, `LM3-END-P060`, `LM3-END-P061`, `LM3-END-P062`, `LM3-ART-P020`, `LM3-ART-P021`, `LM3-ART-P022`, `LM3-ART-P023`, `LM3-ART-P024`, `LM3-ART-P030`, `LM3-ART-P040`, `LM3-ART-P041`, `LM3-AUX-P010`, `LM3-SAF-P010`, `LM3-CTRL-P010`, `LM3-CTRL-P020`, `LM3-CTRL-P030`, `LM3-CTRL-P050`
- Tooling: `LM3-TOOL-LIFT-COLUMNS`, `LM3-TOOL-FINAL-DATUM`
- Joining parts: released bogie-to-body joints; articulation/coupler supplier kits; segregated trainline jumpers; bonding network; configuration-controlled safety/control equipment
- Release gate: All child travelers accepted, train mass/geometry/clearance, brake/door/HV/communications/fire-detection tests, software/configuration hashes, static and low-speed test evidence, open NCR review and independent manufacturing release.

| Seq. | Planning time | Instruction | Hold point |
|---:|---:|---|:---:|
| 10 — Accept child assemblies and final road | 240 min | Verify signed child travelers, serial/configuration records, lifting-column certification, track level and vehicle datum survey; unresolved safety NCRs block marriage. | yes |
| 20 — Bogie marriage and articulation | 600 min | Lift only at released points, roll accepted bogies into surveyed positions, lower onto interfaces, close body/bogie and articulation joints, and independently witness safety-critical locking. | yes |
| 30 — Close trainlines, couplers and remaining fit-out | 480 min | Connect labelled HV/LV/data/coolant/air paths, install end equipment and remaining service panels, then perform continuity, leak, movement-envelope and access checks. | yes |
| 40 — Static systems commissioning | 720 min | Run brake, door/interlock, lighting, HVAC, battery/HVIL, detection, communications, passenger systems, emergency and degraded-mode procedures against released test scripts. | yes |
| 50 — Geometry, mass and water tests | 360 min | Survey ride height/body/articulation/clearance, weigh the train, run roof/door/window ingress tests and reconcile the as-built mass and configuration records. | yes |
| 60 — Independent review and controlled release | 480 min | Review all records and NCRs, freeze software/configuration hashes and issue only a manufacturing release to the authorised low-speed/static test programme—not passenger service approval. | yes |

## External design references

These links explain the engineering basis; they are not copied supplier instructions or a substitute for the selected product's current technical datasheet.

- [ERA LOC&PAS TSI application guide](https://www.era.europa.eu/system/files/2022-11/Guide%20for%20the%20application%20of%20the%20LOC%20%26%20PAS%20TSI%20%28EN%20Version%203.0%20-%2015_02_2021%29.pdf.pdf) — Passenger-door, glazing, structure and rolling-stock evidence gates; deployment authority must select the legally applicable national/current standards.
- [Composites One vacuum infusion process](https://www.compositesone.com/process/closed-molding/vacuum-infusion-process/) — Generic closed-mould sequence: dry reinforcement, vacuum/process materials, resin infusion, controlled cure and demould. Product-specific laminate and resin instructions remain controlling.
- [Sika rail bonding, sealing and glazing application overview](https://gbr.sika.com/dms/getdocument.get/adc08596-e970-4615-8138-966714bd6fd0/Sika%20Transportation-Rail%20Brochure.pdf) — Surface preparation, controlled bead geometry, glazing, floor/interior bonding and exterior sealing process categories; the selected adhesive technical datasheet controls primers, open time, cure and safe handling.
- [Forbo rail flooring installation and maintenance download centre](https://www.forbo.com/transport/en/downloads/rail-downloads/p64bld) — Rail-floor material, installation, cleaning and maintenance evidence route; selected floor and adhesive documents control actual installation.
- [US Department of Energy guidelines for high-reflectance, high-emittance surfaces](https://www.energy.gov/sites/prod/files/2013/10/f3/coolroofguide.pdf) — Screening rationale for measuring solar reflectance and thermal emittance. Building-roof thresholds are not transferred as rail certification or an LM3 performance claim.
- [Böllhoff RIVNUT installation and setting guidance](https://www.boellhoff.com/us-en/services/technical-forum/rivnut-setting-tools/) — One-sided threaded insert installation, perpendicularity, supplier setting force and tool-control principles. Released joint loads and supplier data control selection.
- [Knorr-Bremse IFE modular rail entrance systems](https://rail.knorr-bremse.com/en/us/portfolio/products-and-systems/entrance-systems/) — Complete supplier-owned door cassette, drive, controller, obstacle detection, commissioning and lifecycle boundary.
- [ABB AMXM railway traction motor family](https://www.abb.com/global/en/areas/motion/traction/traction-motor/amxm) — Supplier-frozen railway traction-motor envelope and evidence route; no vendor model or rating is selected by this reference.
